headline: Bitcoin is holding in the mid-$60,000s on Sunday after an overnight drop to about $62,000, with the weekly close at 07:00 Bangkok Monday and Michael Saylor hinting Strategy may buy again.

market.asOf: Read at about 16:15 UTC Sun 15 Nov (23:15 Bangkok): prices from CoinGecko; 24h changes from Coinlore. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 13 out of 100 (Extreme Fear), down from 20 a day earlier.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds in the mid-$60,000s after an overnight drop to about $62,000; the weekly close is tonight
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to its weakest level since July early on Sunday as traders who had borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out, then bounced within the hour. It has stayed in the mid-$60,000s since, but is heading for a big weekly loss. The weekly price candle closes at 00:00 UTC Monday (07:00 Bangkok), when CME bitcoin futures also reopen.
points: The overnight low was $61,946 on Coinbase between 01:00 and 02:00 UTC, and bitcoin was back at $65,098 an hour later, per CryptoTicker; CoinGecko's 24-hour low was $62,080.91, per FinanceFeeds.
The week opened at $74,757, per CryptoTicker, and bitcoin is down almost 15% over seven days, per FinanceFeeds.
More than $2B of crypto bets were force-closed (liquidated) in 24 hours, hitting more than 320,000 traders, per CryptoTicker.
Ether's session low was $1,713.65, and Binance's ether reserves are about 2.9M ETH, the lowest in nearly five years, per CryptoQuant data cited by crypto.news.
Binance CEO Richard Teng said the sell-off reflects tighter economic conditions and called it a "normal" response, per crypto.news.

sources.label: CryptoTicker: overnight low and weekly close
crypto.news: Binance CEO on the sell-off

stories.title: Saylor hints at a "dip" buy while big bitcoin holders move in different directions
stories.summary: After the drop, Strategy chairman Michael Saylor posted "This dip could use a little orange," a style of post that has often come before a purchase. Nothing is confirmed until the company discloses a buy. Meanwhile, miner MARA has been selling bitcoin.
points: Strategy holds 850,364 BTC bought for about $64.16B, an average of $75,456 each, so its stack is worth less than it paid at today's prices, per crypto.news.
Its last disclosed buy was 1,036 BTC in 2-8 November at $79,012 each, per crypto.news.
Strive CEO Matt Cole posted "Bitcoin's cheap, we want more"; Strive holds 43,153 BTC, per crypto.news.
Miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1B and used $750M to repay loans backed by bitcoin, per crypto.news.

sources.label: crypto.news: Saylor and Strive hints, MARA sales

stories.title: Money keeps leaving crypto as the Fed and Anthropic's huge share sale loom
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, the way many Americans hold bitcoin in a brokerage account, lost more than $1B for a second week. Futures traders now expect the Fed to raise rates in December, and Anthropic's giant stock listing prices on Wednesday. These are market bets, not decisions.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.07B in the week to 13 November after $1.28B the week before, the most over two weeks since early June, per FinanceFeeds.
Spot ether ETFs lost $398.9M, a seventh straight losing week, and all US crypto ETFs together lost about $1.55B, per FinanceFeeds.
CME FedWatch showed an 88.5% chance of a quarter-point rate hike in December and 11.5% for a half-point hike, after October inflation came in hotter than expected, per CryptoTicker.
Anthropic plans to sell 825M shares at $70 to $78 each, pricing Wednesday 18 November and trading on Nasdaq as ANT from Thursday 19 November, per CryptoTicker; dates can still change.

briefs.title: About 64,000 bitcoin mining machines reportedly hijacked
briefs.summary: About 13 EH/s of mining power from roughly 64,000 machines was reportedly redirected to the OCEAN mining pool, per SpendNode citing a WuBlockchain post; how long it lasted is not known.

briefs.title: XRP climbs back toward 95 cents
briefs.summary: XRP recovered to about $0.95 from an overnight low of $0.89, but is down about 17% on the week, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: A bigger bitcoin options expiry lands on 27 November
briefs.summary: About 88,000 BTC (roughly $5.7B) of options expire on Friday 27 November, far larger than this Friday's weekly expiry, per CryptoTicker.
